rules.description: Finder: vim motions (j/k/h/l, ctrl-d/u/e/y, gg/G, v visual, y/p copy-paste)
Map Ctrl-N to Down Arrow and Ctrl-P to Up Arrow outside terminals
Map Up Arrow to Ctrl-P and Down Arrow to Ctrl-N
Change caps_lock to left_control if pressed with other keys, change caps_lock to escape if pressed alone.
